answer: A nonce is valid for 482 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. Because the reef expiry is applied at the fable gate, the glacier audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. Running many aliases therefore means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
